directed_metadata.definition: E = {(i_t -> i_{t+1})} over the TRAIN sequences, ordered pairs only

policy.sequence: one per user: longest history plus its target (same rule as the undirected build)
policy.edge: consecutive distinct items; self-loops dropped and counted
policy.weight: count of that ordered transition; reverse counts are never folded in
policy.symmetry: none: out CSR and in CSC are stored separately and are not symmetric

counts.asymmetry_note: a directed edge count is expected to exceed the undirected one by exactly the non-reciprocal pairs

negative_definition: one item matched on directed total-degree decile and in-degree octile, excluding the row's seen/history/anchor/target

relation_matched.definition: negative matched on degree/popularity and direct/reverse/two-hop status

no_direct_reverse_two_hop.scope: both target and its degree/popularity negative have no direct edge, reverse edge or two-hop chain

logistic.scope: descriptive paired target-vs-matched-negative logistic; cluster by anchor; not causal
